description: RealOpen helps buyers use crypto to buy real estate. Verify wallet ownership, check crypto Proof of Funds eligibility, generate a Proof of Funds letter, and start your crypto-funded real estate purchase directly through ChatGPT. When you’re ready to purchase, the transaction takes place outside ChatGPT through RealOpen, where your crypto is converted and fiat funds are sent to the seller or escrow.

defaultPrompt: Can I get a proof of funds letter to buy a house with my crypto?
How do I verify my wallet so I can use it for proof of funds?
